components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string

## Summary

I changed telephone handling to store and compare numbers in **E.164 form**.

### Core logic — `NormalizeOwnerTelephone.java`
Rewrote the normalization step (runs in the `POST /api/owners` OfficeFloor pipeline):
- Strips spaces, dashes, and brackets.
- If a leading `+` is present, keeps it and its country code as-is.
- Otherwise assumes `+61` and drops a single leading `0` from the national digits.
- Requires **8–15 digits after the `+`**; anything else (or stray non-digit characters) is rejected as **400** via `MethodArgumentNotValidException` on the `telephone` field.
- Writes the E.164 string back onto the request, so it's persisted and returned as `telephone`. E.g. `0412 345 678` → `+61412345678`.

Duplicate detection (`EnsureOwnerTelephoneUnique`) needed no logic change — because the normalized E.164 value is stored, `findByTelephone` now compares E.164 values.

### Supporting changes
- **`Owner.java`** — the entity's telephone `@Pattern` was `^[0-9]{10}$` (which Hibernate enforces on save and which E.164 would violate). Widened it to `^(\+[0-9]{8,15}|[0-9]{10})$` so E.164 values persist, while still accepting legacy 10-digit values that other tests seed via direct entity saves. Removed the now-unused `@Digits`.
- **`openapi.yml`** — updated the telephone field description and example to E.164.

### Tests
The V1 controller tests hit the same OfficeFloor endpoint (there are no Spring `@RestController` classes) and pinned the old 10-digit contract, so I updated the four that encoded it to the new behaviour: E.164 output (`+616085550002`), a too-short reject (`12` → `+6112`), a too-long reject (16 digits after `+`), and the duplicate case (existing owner stored as `+616085551999`). The new `AcceptanceTest` cases pass unchanged.
